candidate_027_refinement.evidence_pattern: Across this panel several agents themselves identify that the observable or proxy they used is not equivalent to the scientific construct in the claim: database 'uncultured' label versus failed cultivability attempt; exact substring versus >=97% representative matching; union-over-all-conditions recoverability versus standard-condition PCC; assumed PCT_true versus measured PCT; and one colony-forming cell versus sustained cultivability.
candidate_027_refinement.repair_trigger: If an explicit review finds the operational definition non-equivalent to the claimed construct, close promotion until one of four things happens: rerun with a construct-faithful observable; establish a justified bridge relation; materially narrow all load-bearing claim surfaces to exactly what was measured; or hard block/reject. Disclosure alone does not close the issue.
